modifications: Source text is decoded losslessly from Big5 where required.
Traditional Chinese move notation is normalized to canonical UCI moves.
Records are legality-validated and indexed for offline browsing, replay, and practice.
Move and tag payloads are losslessly compressed in the normalized SQLite database.
Invalid or ambiguous records are quarantined rather than silently repaired.
Public ICCS game collections are replay-validated, deduplicated, and transformed into the normalized SQLite format for offline learning and replay.
